opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non‑profit organisations (UK and international) for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences, Lectures and Publications, Long‑Term Research grants; individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) for Research and Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Supports the growth and development of sculpture through grants for projects such as exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, research, publications and travel.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: UK – up to £600; Europe – up to £700; Rest of world – up to £1,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture; artists for Artist Research Fellowships; senior scholars for Senior Fellowships; applicants must be able to use the Institute’s research facilities.
opportunities.summary: One‑month fellowships to conduct research using the Henry Moore Institute’s library, archive and sculpture collections, with travel and subsistence funding.
